q1: SELECT EMAIL AS EMAIL FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL HAVING COUNT(EMAIL) >1
q2: SELECT DISTINCT EMAIL FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL HAVING COUNT(EMAIL)>=2
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT EMAIL AS EMAIL FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL HAVING COUNT(EMAIL) >1
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT EMAIL FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL HAVING COUNT(EMAIL)>=2
explanation: Both Q1 and Q2 aim to find emails that are associated with more than one person in the PERSON table. The difference lies in the use of DISTINCT in Q2, which does not change the outcome in this context since GROUP BY already ensures distinctness.
